messages:
Jules (Finance): Quick flag — INV-2026-409 for Kaplan GmbH shows Platform Fee EUR 92,000 but quote had EUR 72,000. Can we reconcile?
BillingBot: Invoice INV-2026-409 generated. Total: EUR 116,500. Lines: platform_private: EUR 92,000; support_premium: EUR 20,000; setup: EUR 4,500.
Ravi (FinanceOps): I see a 'private-deploy-region-surcharge' EUR 20,000 in the billing export. Contracted SOW v1 shows Platform Base EUR 72,000 with no region uplift.
Sofia (Account Executive): Customer requested EU-only deploy and paid an onetime PS of EUR 4,500. Sales ops did not authorize a recurring region surcharge. I have the signed SOW attached.
Emil (Customer Success): We spun up a 10-node test cluster 2026-02-02 for performance validation; tagged as 'trial' in provisioning notes. Billing imported both trial and prod nodes for the Jan billing window.
Ravi (FinanceOps): So two issues: region surcharge added incorrectly, and trial nodes billed. Drafting credit memo CM-9340 for -EUR 20,000 and CM-9341 for -EUR 2,500 (trial month).
Jules (Finance): Need corrected invoice + credit memos and an explanation note for AP contact ap@kaplan.de by Tue EOD CET.
Sofia (Account Executive): Sales will confirm that no recurring uplift was agreed. If customer signs a CO we can re-bill prospectively; verbal approvals are not enough for recurring changes per Legal.
LegalBot: Per policy, recurring fee changes require signed change order. One-time professional services can be billed with email approval but must be listed as 'one-time' on invoice.
Ravi (FinanceOps): Created ticket BILL-4477. CM drafts created and pending approval. Will revert region surcharge and remove trial nodes upon approval.
Emil (Customer Success): I'll prepare the customer-facing note: 'Removed trial provisioning charges and incorrect region uplift'. Will wait for draft invoice to review.
Jules (Finance): Please post the corrected invoice here when ready. Target turnaround: 48 hours.
Sofia (Account Executive): On it. Adding AP contact to thread. :white_check_mark:
